title: stylophorum simplicifolium
intro: Stylophorum simplicifolium, commonly known as Goldenseal or Canker Rose, is a flowering plant native to eastern North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne, as well as respiratory issues like bronchitis and coughs. Stylophorum simplicifolium contains bioactive constituents like berberine, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities.
